rows.definition: The durable content-addressed on-disk byte store backing the RAM-only ctxrestore stash, keyed by a dropped media turn's sha256 digest (#5163).
rows.distinction: The restart/eviction-surviving on-disk half of ctxrestore; the stash proper is RAM-only and non-durable.

rows.definition: Const naming the FAK_CTXRESTORE_CAS_DIR environment variable that overrides or disables the durable media-restore CAS directory.
rows.distinction: The env-var NAME const, distinct from the resolved directory value it selects (ctxRestoreCASDir).

rows.definition: The literal environment-variable string overriding the durable media-restore CAS directory; 'off'/'0'/'none' disable durable persistence.
rows.distinction: The literal env string, distinct from the const ctxRestoreCASEnvDir that holds it.

rows.definition: The default workspace-relative durable media-restore CAS directory (.fak/ctxrestore/cas) used when the env override is unset.
rows.distinction: The default relative path, distinct from the env override and from the resolved absolute dir.

rows.definition: Cap constant bounding the durable media-restore CAS directory, oldest-modified-out on overflow (the disk analogue of the stash caps).
rows.distinction: The durable-store capacity bound, distinct from the RAM stash's maxCtxRestoreEntriesPerSession cap.

rows.definition: Helper resolving the durable media-restore CAS directory from the environment at call time; empty string means durable persistence is off.
rows.distinction: The resolver accessor, distinct from the env-var name const ctxRestoreCASEnvDir and the default relative path ctxRestoreCASDirRel it chooses between.

rows.definition: The gateway's per-turn split of in-kernel prompt tokens by PROVENANCE source (local_compute / local_cache_hit / external_kv_transfer), orthogonal to the reuse-depth family; the three sum to the by-source prompt tokens. external_kv_transfer isolates the disaggregation dividend — tokens a remote / L3 KV tier served that a single box would otherwise have re-prefilled.
rows.distinction: Splits the SAME prompt tokens by WHERE reuse came from (source axis); distinct from x2-gateway-engine-fakgatewaykvprefix, the reuse-DEPTH family that measures HOW MUCH was reused.
